description: Fill a non-constant 2.2 second gap with one PCHIP-derived event while preserving the exact duration.

oracle.description: The gap baseline is 1.05 s. PCHIP at compressed coordinates 1 and 2 yields 1.038047138047138 and 1.0619528619528622 s before common rescaling to the exact 2.2 s gap duration.
